name: 이안

sources.title: 님블뉴런 공식 1.0.0 실험체: 해방 / 넌 벗어날 수 없어

visual_review: 창백한 금발과 지친 붉은 눈·단검을 유지했습니다. 웅크린 인간에서 귀신이 분리되어 수평 돌진·귀수 공격·되돌아오는 변신이 읽힙니다. 5~8번째의 영체 상승/비행은 의도된 모션입니다.
motion_summary: Ian pale ash-blonde long hair with red sleepy eyes, brown-black schoollike outfit and small dagger, dark possession aura from portrait. Official R releases a ghost from her body in the chosen direction, leaving human body behind, then becomes human when finished. Show representative transformation: idle troubled human; hand to chest; crouching with trembling shoulders; violet-black ghost claws emerge behind; spectral form erupts forward right with long dark clawed arms while small human body remains left; ghost fully separates lunging low; sweeping claw attack; tall spectral recoil; ghost draws back into her; pale face reappears through fading violet mist; human rises; original idle. Ghost is HER unique possession spirit, not an unrelated monster; preserve distinctive hair/face motifs across forms. No gore, no generic enemy. All fits each cell.
